In the headlines: “Markets rally for 3rd day in row, Sensex ends above 81,900 on FII inflows & lower oil prices” (MillenniumPost). “Middle East latest: Trump says US no longer needs Iran deal” (The National).
One session says little about the long run. Oil, the Iran war and foreign flows remain the big swing factors.

drivers.p: Brent is down 2.2% in a week. India imports most of its crude, so cheaper oil eases inflation, supports the rupee and helps oil users.
The rupee is at 94.03 per dollar, stronger than a week ago. A firmer rupee eases import costs and tends to steady foreign investors.
